product_metadata.title: UNILIBRA Twin XL Size Bamboo Mattress Pad Cooling, Quilted Fitted Mattress Protector Pillow Top Extra Long Mattress Cover with Deep Pocket Up to 19 Inches, Ultra Soft Filling Mattress Pad
features: ✅【Advanced Bamboo Top Queen Mattress Pad】Surfaced with 45% organic bamboo fiber, 3 times the breathability of normal cotton, this queen size bamboo mattress pad (39"x80") bring you a cooling touch, achieves a perfect balcane to be warm in winter and cool in summer, comfortable all year round!

✅【Ultra Soft Queen Mattress Pad】Overfilled with 12oz latest designed 5D spiral fiber, making this queen size mattress pad super fluffy, add an extra softness to your firm mattress or foam mattress. Let you sleep like on a cloud, yet provides support to your back.

✅【Unique Honeycomb Design】The bamboo queen mattress protector is ergonomically designed with honeycomb, comfortable as a fluffy soft nest - like barrier between you and your mattress, make your sleep life more comfortable in the sense you won’t get pressure points.

✅【Deep Pocket Queen Mattress Pad】This fitted bamboo mattress pad for queen size bed could stretch up to 19" thick mattress, protect all sides of your dear mattress, keeps the mattress fixed in place all the time, whether it's a regular mattress, a waterbed, or memory. No more worries about slipping or moving!

✅【Machine Washable Queen Mattress Cover】Wrinkle-resistant queen size mattress cover is easy to care, it doesn’t need professional cleaning.Just put this in the washing machine with a gentle cycle and temperature below 30. Dry it under the sunshine and it will be fluffy after completely dried.
